user.title: Set up a Teltonika NTP server
user.description: Enter the address and WebUI credentials of your Teltonika NTP server (for example the NTP001).

data_description.host: IP address or host name. HTTPS is tried first, then HTTP.
data_description.username: A WebUI user. A dedicated read-only user for Home Assistant is recommended.
data_description.verify_ssl: Leave off for the device's default self-signed certificate.

dhcp_confirm.title: Teltonika NTP server discovered
dhcp_confirm.description: {name} was found at {host}. Enter its WebUI credentials to add it.

data_description.username: A WebUI user. A dedicated read-only user for Home Assistant is recommended.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to {name} again
reauth_confirm.description: The device at {host} rejected the stored credentials.

data_description.username: A WebUI user. A dedicated read-only user for Home Assistant is recommended.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Teltonika NTP server

data_description.host: IP address or host name. HTTPS is tried first, then HTTP.
data_description.username: A WebUI user. A dedicated read-only user for Home Assistant is recommended.
data_description.verify_ssl: Leave off for the device's default self-signed certificate.

reconfigure.description: Change the address or credentials of the device.

abort.not_supported: This Teltonika device is not an NTP server. Use the built-in Teltonika integration for routers.
